[[File:Ossus_Keeper_Robe.jpg|thumb|175px|Robe from the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]]]
'''Ossus Keeper robes''' were worn by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served as [[Ossus Keeper|Keepers]] of the [[Hall of Knowledge/Legends|Hall of Knowledge]] in the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] before it's destruction during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] in [[3996 BBY]]. These [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] significantly increased the mental attributes of the Keepers and aided them in maintaining the protected archives in addition to guiding those who wished for interactive solutions to their problems.

[[Meetra Surik]] was rumored to have received a set of these robes as a gift from [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] for her help during the [[Onderon Civil War]] in [[3951 BBY]].
